name: V09_streets
note: Street centrelines within about 600 m of the site (segments with any vertex inside a 1,200 m square), from the Beyond Data tool's streets_van.json. Source: City of Vancouver Open Data, Public streets (downloaded 16 Oct 2026) and Lanes (downloaded 18 Oct 2026; lane surface not recorded). 'flag_as_stored' is an unlabelled flag in the tool data (the tool's route search treats 0 differently); not interpreted.
